parameters: \rZinnia: And how did the story end?
\rAfter being transformed by the wish of the people, did Rayquaza save them from disaster?
\rRayquaza once again confronted Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre.
\rThe golden filaments that sprang from its body covered the sky.
\rAn emerald brilliance illuminated the area.\nA terrible wind rose.
\rThe wind and emerald light visibly sapped the power from Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre.
\rDrained of their primal powers, the two vanished into the depths of land and sea.
\rThen it soared back up into the heavens where it dwelled.
\rA witness to this series of events, a tall visitor from a distant land, said, “It is the <icon=DELTA> (Delta), born of the great disturbances in this world.
\r“By the bonds born of mankind's wish and the power of the stones, it will calm the troubles that plague the world.”
\rThat was when the Draconids constructed their great tower, to hold the rainbow stone that had granted Rayquaza its power, and to try to get a little bit closer to
\rTo record the history of their trials and the great feats of mighty Rayquaza for all to know, they left behind the murals you see here.
\rA giant tower…\nAnd paintings of the past…
\rYou know, I feel like I've seen something like that recently.
\rHeh. But now, I suppose it's time for the last chapter in our tale.
